scope: Passive source/AST review of root-owned fixed host recording recipe only; no reviewed module imports or fixture/compiler/model/tool/product execution, Git, service or target access.

fixed_recipe.compile: Exact cc label mapped to /usr/bin/cc with -UNDEBUG and required ASan/UBSan; single -o destination beneath active group/work; timeout120s.
fixed_recipe.execution: Only single retained output executable; each successful group must execute its own just-recorded compiler product; timeout45s.
fixed_recipe.environment: Rejects compiler include/library and sanitizer override variables named in code. This is a finite reviewed fixture recipe, not a general arbitrary-command security boundary.
fixed_recipe.raw_retention: stdout/stderr files opened before each call, argv/cwd/group/timeout saved before effect, elapsed/result/failure saved in finally; products kept in persistent group/work and hash recorded after successful compile.
fixed_recipe.temporary_directories: Replacement owns one persistent directory per fixture group; no cleanup on exit.
fixed_recipe.first_failure: First failing group/command aborts later groups, retains report/raw outputs/products and restores patched APIs; no retry loop.
fixed_recipe.source_binding: Full candidate inventory must equal pending source-controls manifest before any fixture import and again after run; source change changes report status and process exits1.
fixed_recipe.imports: sys.dont_write_bytecode=True before any candidate imports prevents cache files from changing the exact inventory; root has additionally specified -B invocation.
fixed_recipe.restoration: subprocess.run and TemporaryDirectory restored in finally before source-after report.
fixed_recipe.unittest: Per-group complete verbose unittest result retained; only one successful discovered test and exact compile/product pair can advance.

resolved_preseal_observations: Added exact one-test/two-call/same-product-per-group and total5/10 success gates.
